tips.title: Air-fryer helper
tips.text: Air-fry one of the four onions (1 tbsp oil, 160 °C, 15–25 minutes, tossing every 5) while the other three fry on the stove. A lighter kadai browns faster and more evenly.

recipes.title: Chicken Donne Biryani
recipes.sub: Bengaluru military-hotel classic · from the Donne mushroom master
recipes.intro: The biryani Bengaluru's military hotels are famous for. The chicken cooks in the green masala before the rice goes in.

items.name: Green masala
items.note: mint, coriander, green chillies, ginger, garlic, whole spices

steps: Grind the green masala first, then marinate the chicken with 2 tbsp of it, the curd, a pinch of salt and turmeric for at least 30 minutes.
Wash and soak the rice. Fry the onion base and cook the green masala exactly as in the Donne master recipe.
When the masala is deep green with oil at the edges, add the chicken and marinade. Cook on high 3 minutes, then covered on medium-low 12–15 minutes.
Check: only a faint pink at the bone and the juices reduced to a thick gravy.
Add the rice and hot water, boil uncovered until holes appear, then dum 15 minutes on the tawa and rest 10.

tips.title: Pressure cooker
tips.text: Cook the chicken to 80% in the cooker base, add the rice and 1¼ cups hot water for 2 servings, close when it boils and cook 1 whistle on medium.

recipes.title: Andhra Paneer Biryani
recipes.sub: From the Andhra chicken master
recipes.intro: The Andhra masala and layered rice with paneer. Paneer needs only a short marination and a quick turn in the masala.
steps: Slice the onions and fry the birista first; the paneer needs no long marination.
Wash and soak the rice. Marinate the paneer for 20 minutes.
Make the masala as in the master (tempering, onion, tomato, slit chillies), add the chilli paste and 3 tbsp water and cook 3 minutes to a thick gravy.
Fold in the paneer with its marinade and some crushed birista on medium-low for 4–5 minutes. Taste: salty and spicy.
Par-boil the rice to 75%, layer, dum 12 minutes and rest 10.

tips.title: Air fryer
tips.text: Sear the paneer at 200 °C for 6 minutes before marinating.

recipes.title: Andhra Egg Biryani
recipes.sub: From the Andhra chicken master
recipes.intro: Boiled eggs, blistered and turned in a thick Andhra gravy, under saffron rice.
steps: Boil the eggs (air fryer 130 °C, 15 minutes) while you slice onions and fry the birista.
Slash each egg 3 times, rub with chilli, turmeric and salt and blister 1–2 minutes in birista oil, or air-fry at 200 °C for 4–5 minutes.
Make the masala, then add the curd mixed with all the marinade spices and cook 8–10 minutes on medium-low until thick.
Turn the eggs and some birista in the gravy for 2 minutes. Layer with 75% rice, dum 12 minutes, rest 10.

tips.title: Kolkata touch
tips.text: Add a small potato per serving, halved and fried or air-fried golden, with the eggs.

recipes.title: Lucknowi Chicken Biryani
recipes.sub: The original Awadhi biryani · from the Lucknowi paneer master
recipes.intro: Chicken marinated in curd and gentle spices, cooked in a cashew-birista gravy, under rice boiled in spiced yakhni.

items.name: White pepper / cardamom powder / garam masala

steps: Start the yakhni and marinate the chicken at the same time (45 minutes to 2 hours).
Temper whole spices and slit chillies in ghee, add the chicken and cook 5 minutes on medium.
Stir in the cashew-birista paste, cover and cook 15–18 minutes until 85% done with 3–4 tbsp of creamy gravy.
Par-boil the rice in the yakhni, layer, dum 18 minutes and rest 10.

recipes.title: Mutton Biryani (pressure-cooker pakki)
recipes.sub: Andhra style · safe without a fridge
recipes.intro: Mutton is pressure-cooked to tender in its masala, then layered and finished on dum. Kacchi biryani needs 6–12 hours of marinating, which isn't safe without a fridge.
steps: Marinate the mutton with papaya paste, curd and spices for 1½ hours (never more than 2).
In the cooker base, temper whole spices, fry the onion golden, then tomato and chillies.
Add the mutton and marinade, cook on high 6–7 minutes, add ¼ cup water, close and cook 4 whistles on medium plus 5 minutes on the lowest flame. Let the pressure drop.
Test: a knife slides in with slight resistance. Boil uncovered to 2–3 thick tablespoons of gravy.
Par-boil the rice, layer, dum 20 minutes on the tawa and rest 10.

tips.title: Cookers differ
tips.text: Young goat usually needs 3–4 whistles, older goat 5–6. Check at 4 the first time and note it.

recipes.title: Vegetable Biryani
recipes.sub: Andhra or Lucknowi masala
recipes.intro: Mixed vegetables marinated briefly and cooked to 80% in the masala before layering.
steps: Soak the cauliflower in hot salted water for 10 minutes.
Fry the potato cubes golden (or air-fry at 200 °C for 12–15 minutes with 1 tsp oil).
Marinate the other vegetables for 20 minutes.
Make the masala, add the vegetables with 3 tbsp water and cover-cook 8–10 minutes until 80% done; fold in the potatoes.
Layer with 75% rice, dum 15 minutes and rest 10.

recipes.title: Fish Biryani
recipes.sub: Andhra masala, with a coastal option
recipes.intro: Firm fish, briefly marinated and firmed by quick frying, goes between two layers of finished masala and cooks gently on dum.

items.name: Coastal option: curry leaves / coconut milk

steps: Fry the birista, then wash and soak the rice.
Clean the fish and marinate it 15–20 minutes, no longer.
Make the masala and cook the curd-spice mix 8–10 minutes until thick. Coastal: curry leaves in the tempering, coconut milk for the last 2 minutes.
Shallow-fry the fish 1 minute a side until just firm outside (or air-fry 200 °C, 6 minutes).
Layer: half the masala, the fish, the rest of the masala, then rice. Dum 12 minutes, rest 10. Never stir.

recipes.title: Prawn Biryani, two ways
recipes.sub: Andhra layered or donne one-pot
recipes.intro: Prawns cook in minutes, so they're sautéed only to a loose C and finish in the steam.

items.name: Chilli powder / turmeric / salt / ginger-garlic / lemon

steps: Marinate the prawns 10–15 minutes only; start this when you start the masala.
Sauté on high about 1 minute a side until pink and curled into a loose C (air fryer: 200 °C, 4–5 minutes).
Way A, Andhra layered: fold into the finished masala off the heat, layer and dum 10–12 minutes.
Way B, donne one-pot: follow the donne master without mushrooms; push the prawns into the rice once the water has boiled down, cover and dum 12 minutes.

tips.title: Tight O means overcooked
tips.text: A loose C is cooked; a tight O is rubbery.

recipes.title: Soya Chunk Biryani
recipes.sub: High-protein vegetarian
recipes.intro: Boiled, squeezed soya chunks soak up the Andhra marinade like meat.
steps: Boil the chunks 5 minutes in salted water, rinse twice and squeeze hard.
Marinate 20–30 minutes. For a meatier bite, air-fry the chunks at 200 °C for 6–8 minutes and return them to the marinade.
Make the masala, add the chunks with the marinade and 2 tbsp water, cover and cook 8 minutes, keeping 3–4 tbsp of gravy.
Layer with 75% rice, dum 15 minutes and rest 10.

recipes.title: Lean Chicken Breast Donne Biryani
recipes.sub: Built for protein and a smaller waist
recipes.intro: Chicken breast in big chunks, marinated in hung curd and cooked only to 80% before the rice goes in, so it stays juicy.

items.name: Green masala
items.note: 1 tbsp of it for the marinade

steps: Grind the green masala and marinate the chicken in hung curd, a spoon of the masala, salt, turmeric and lemon for 30 minutes. Soak the rice.
Temper whole spices, fry the onion (a splash of water if it sticks), then tomato and the rest of the masala for 6–7 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook 6–8 minutes on medium until white outside and slightly pink inside.
Add the rice, hot water, salt and lemon; boil uncovered until holes appear. Dum 12 minutes, rest 10.

recipes.title: Air-fryer Chicken 65
recipes.sub: The classic Andhra side
recipes.intro: Crisp, spicy boneless chicken. Air-fry it during the biryani's dum so it's hot when the biryani is ready.

items.name: Turmeric / garam masala / salt
items.q: a pinch / ¼ tsp / ¼ tsp

items.name: To finish: oil / curry leaves / slit chilli / garlic

steps: Mix everything except the oil and finishing items into the chicken and marinate 30 minutes.
Preheat to 200 °C. Shake off excess coating, lay the pieces in one layer and brush with oil.
Cook 12–14 minutes, turning and brushing again at 7. No pink inside, juices clear.
Fry the curry leaves, chilli and garlic in a little oil for 30 seconds and toss the chicken in it.

recipes.title: Air-fryer Shami Kebab
recipes.sub: The Lucknowi side · chicken or mutton
recipes.intro: Soft, spiced patties of meat and chana dal, crisped in the air fryer with 2 tsp of oil.

items.name: Mint and coriander / garam masala / lemon

steps: Pressure-cook everything above the egg for 3 whistles (mutton 6–7).
Cook uncovered on high, stirring, 5–8 minutes until completely dry. Cool 10 minutes; remove bay leaf and cinnamon.
Grind to a smooth, dough-like paste without water. Mix in the egg, herbs, garam masala and lemon.
Shape 8 patties 6 cm across, 1.5 cm thick. Brush with oil and air-fry at 200 °C for 10–12 minutes, turning at 6.

recipes.title: Mirchi ka salan
recipes.sub: Long chillies in peanut-sesame gravy
recipes.intro: The classic partner for Andhra and Hyderabadi biryani. It tastes better after resting, so make it before the biryani.
steps: Dry-roast the peanuts 3–4 minutes, then the sesame, coconut, cumin and coriander 1–2 minutes. Cool and grind smooth with ¼ cup water.
Blister the chillies in the oil for 2 minutes and lift out (or brush with ½ tsp oil and air-fry at 200 °C for 5–6 minutes).
Temper the seeds and curry leaves, fry the onion golden, then ginger-garlic, turmeric and chilli.
Fry the paste 2–3 minutes on low, add tamarind, jaggery, salt and water and simmer 8–10 minutes. Return the chillies for 3 minutes; rest 20.

recipes.title: Double ka meetha
recipes.sub: Hyderabadi bread pudding · sandwich maker
recipes.intro: Traditionally made with deep-fried bread; the sandwich maker gives the same crisp bread with one tablespoon of ghee.
steps: Simmer the milk in a wide, heavy pan 15–20 minutes, stirring and scraping, until reduced by half. Add sugar, cardamom and saffron.
Brush the bread with ghee and toast in the closed sandwich maker 3–4 minutes until deep golden. Cut into triangles.
Arrange in one layer, pour the warm milk over and leave 5–10 minutes. Top with nuts. Eat within 2 hours.

tips.title: Shahi tukda
tips.text: Reduce the milk to a third (rabri) and finish with pistachios: the partner for Lucknowi biryani.

recipes.title: Burani raita (garlic raita)
recipes.sub: For Lucknowi biryani
recipes.intro: Curd with garlic fried golden in ghee, poured sizzling over the top.
steps: Whisk the curd with salt and a spoon of water.
Fry the garlic in ghee on low 1–2 minutes until light golden (brown garlic is bitter) and pour over.
Top with cumin, chilli and mint.

Top with the onion, tomato and coriander, spices and lemon. Eat at once.

recipes.title: Jeera rice
recipes.sub: Cumin rice by absorption
recipes.intro: Pairs with dal or any curry.
steps: Temper the cumin and bay leaf in ghee until the cumin crackles and darkens slightly.
Add the drained rice and stir gently 1 minute. Add the hot water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest flame 12 minutes. Rest 5 minutes covered, then fluff.

recipes.title: Ghee rice (Malabar style)
recipes.sub: With cashews, raisins and golden onion
recipes.intro: Pairs with chicken or mutton curry.

items.name: Ghee
items.note: ½ tbsp on the air-fryer route

steps: Fry the cashews and raisins in the ghee and lift out; fry the onion golden and keep half for garnish.
Temper the whole spices, add the rice and stir 1 minute, then the hot water and salt.
Boil, cover and cook on the lowest flame 12 minutes. Rest 5 and top with nuts, raisins and onion.

tips.title: Air-fryer route
tips.text: Air-fry the cashews and raisins (160 °C, 3–4 minutes) and the onion as birista; then ½ tbsp ghee is enough.

recipes.title: Vegetable pulao (pressure cooker)
recipes.sub: One whistle, one pot
recipes.intro: A quick one-pot rice with whole spices and vegetables.
steps: In the cooker base, temper the whole spices; fry the onion light golden, then ginger-garlic and chilli.
Add vegetables and mint for 2 minutes, then the rice, hot water, salt and lemon.
Close, 1 whistle on medium; let the pressure drop by itself.

recipes.title: Chitranna (Karnataka lemon rice)
recipes.sub: Tempered lemon rice with peanuts
recipes.intro: Cook the rice, cool it 10 minutes so the grains stay separate, then fold into the tempering.
steps: Cook the rice and spread it on a plate to cool 10 minutes.
Temper the mustard, dals and peanuts until golden; add the chillies, curry leaves, hing and turmeric.
Off the heat add lemon and salt, then fold in the rice and coriander.
